170	    ) -> None:
171	        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
172	        self._debounce = debounce
173	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
174	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
175	        self._observer = None
176	        self._observer_start_attempted = False
177	        self._started = False
178	        self._starting = False
179	        self._stopping = False
180	        self._stop_requested = False
181	
182	    @staticmethod
183	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer, start_attempted: bool) -> bool:
184	        errors = False
185	        try:
186	            observer.stop()
187	        except Exception:
188	            errors = True
189	            _LOG.error("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
190	        if start_attempted:
191	            try:
192	                observer.join(timeout=10)
193	            except Exception:
194	                errors = True
195	                _LOG.error("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
196	
197	        try:
198	            alive = observer.is_alive()
199	        except Exception:
200	            errors = True
201	            alive = True
202	            _LOG.error("Failed to check database watcher state after startup failure")
203	        if alive:
204	            _LOG.error("Database watcher remained alive after startup failure cleanup")
205	        return not errors and not alive
206	
207	    def start(self) -> None:
208	        with self._condition:
209	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
210	                self._condition.wait()
211	            if self._started:
212	                return
213	            self._starting = True
214	            self._stop_requested = False
215	
216	        parent = self._database_path.parent
217	        try:
218	            if not parent.is_dir():
219	                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
220	        except Exception:
221	            with self._condition:
222	                self._starting = False
223	                self._stop_requested = False
224	                self._condition.notify_all()
225	            raise
226	
227	        observer = None
228	        try:
229	            observer = self._observer_factory()
230	            with self._condition:
231	                self._observer = observer
232	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
233	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
234	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
235	            # Mark the attempt before calling into watchdog: start() may launch a
236	            # thread and then raise, so cleanup must still stop, join, and inspect it.
237	            with self._condition:
238	                self._observer_start_attempted = True
239	            observer.start()
240	        except Exception:
241	            cleanup_succeeded = (
242	                observer is None
243	                or self._cleanup_after_start_failure(
244	                    observer, self._observer_start_attempted
245	                )
246	            )
247	            with self._condition:
248	                if cleanup_succeeded:
249	                    if self._observer is observer:
250	                        self._observer = None
251	                    self._observer_start_attempted = False
252	                    self._started = False
253	                    self._stop_requested = False
254	                else:
255	                    # Keep a live or incompletely cleaned observer available for stop() to retry.
256	                    self._started = observer is not None
257	                self._starting = False
258	                self._condition.notify_all()
259	            raise
260	
261	        with self._condition:
262	            self._started = True
263	            self._starting = False
264	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
265	            self._condition.notify_all()
266	
267	        if stop_requested:
268	            self.stop()
269	
270	    def stop(self) -> None:
271	        with self._condition:
272	            if self._starting:
273	                self._stop_requested = True
274	                while self._starting:
275	                    self._condition.wait()
276	            while self._stopping:
277	                self._condition.wait()
278	                if not self._started:
279	                    return
280	            if not self._started:
281	                return
282	            observer = self._observer
283	            start_attempted = self._observer_start_attempted
284	            self._stopping = True
285	
286	        errors = []
287	        try:
288	            try:
289	                observer.stop()
290	            except Exception as exc:
291	                errors.append(exc)
292	                _LOG.error("Failed to stop database watcher")
293	            if start_attempted:
294	                try:
295	                    observer.join(timeout=10)
296	                except Exception as exc:
297	                    errors.append(exc)
298	                    _LOG.error("Failed to join database watcher")
299	
300	            alive = False

302	                alive = observer.is_alive()
303	            except Exception as exc:
304	                errors.append(exc)
305	                _LOG.error("Failed to check database watcher state")
306	            if alive:
307	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
308	        finally:
309	            with self._condition:
310	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
311	                if cleanup_succeeded:
312	                    self._started = False
313	                    self._observer = None
314	                    self._observer_start_attempted = False
315	                    self._stop_requested = False
316	                self._stopping = False
317	                self._condition.notify_all()
318	
319	        if errors:

44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

158	### Git 和分支
159	
160	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。

168	### SDD 流程
169	
170	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。

177	### Things3 只读边界
178	
179	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
180	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
181	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
182	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
183	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
184	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
185	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
186	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
187	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
188

190	
191	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
192	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
193	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
194	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
195	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。

199	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。

201	### Git 实现
202	
203	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。

212	- 所有错误日志必须使用固定消息，不得输出异常文本或 traceback。
213	- 任何包含数据库路径、仓库路径、token、auth-token、password 的异常消息都必须在日志外出现。

216

218	
219	- 优先使用 `/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python`，系统 Python 可能没有 pytest。

226	- 每次任务的报告要记录 RED/GREEN 命令、精确输出和未执行的检查。
227	
228	### Workflow / 子代理
229	
230	- 本项目使用 Workflow 工具派发 implementer 与独立 reviewer，脚本必须是纯 JavaScript，不能用 TypeScript 语法。

docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1741:`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.
docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1743:Use daemon timers, but `stop(wait=True)` must wait on the condition until `_running` becomes false. Do not hold the condition while executing the sync callback.
docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1747:`DatabaseWatcher.start()` verifies `database_path.parent` exists, schedules one non-recursive watch on that parent, and starts the observer. `stop()` calls `observer.stop()` then `observer.join(timeout=10)`; if still alive, log an error. Starting twice or stopping before start is idempotent.

1	"""Run the Things snapshot sync and own its background components."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	from typing import Optional
6	
7	from .config import AppConfig
8	from .git_ops import GitClient
9	from .sync_engine import SyncEngine
10	from .things_adapter import ThingsReader, discover_database_path, load_default_api
11	from .watcher import DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
12	
13	
14	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SyncService:
18	    """Coordinate startup, periodic synchronization, and graceful shutdown."""
19	
20	    def __init__(
21	        self,
22	        engine,
23	        watcher,
24	        debouncer,
25	        full_sync_interval: float,
26	        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,
27	    ) -> None:
28	        self.engine = engine
29	        self.watcher = watcher
30	        self.debouncer = debouncer
31	        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
32	        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
33	        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
34	        self._stop_requested = False
35	
36	    def run(self) -> None:
37	        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
38	        self.engine.sync()
39	        try:
40	            with self._stop_lock:
41	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
42	                    return
43	                self.watcher.start()
44	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
45	                    return
46	            while not self.stop_event.wait(self.full_sync_interval):
47	                with self._stop_lock:
48	                    if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
49	                        break
50	                    try:
51	                        self.engine.sync()
52	                    except Exception:
53	                        logger.error("Scheduled full sync failed")
54	        finally:
55	            try:
56	                self.watcher.stop()
57	            except Exception:
58	                logger.error("Watcher cleanup failed")
59	            try:
60	                self.debouncer.stop(wait=True)
61	            except Exception:
62	                logger.error("Debouncer cleanup failed")
63	
64	    def stop(self) -> None:
65	        """Request shutdown once; repeated requests have no additional effect."""
66	        with self._stop_lock:
67	            if self._stop_requested:
68	                return
69	            self._stop_requested = True
70	            self.stop_event.set()
71	
72	
73	def build_service(config: AppConfig) -> SyncService:
74	    """Construct the complete service graph from application configuration."""
75	    database_path = discover_database_path(config.things_db)
76	    reader = ThingsReader(load_default_api(), database_path)
77	    git_client = GitClient(config.repo_path, timeout=config.git_timeout_seconds)
78	    engine = SyncEngine(config, reader, git_client)
79	    debouncer = DebouncedSync(engine.sync_if_idle, config.watch_debounce_seconds)
80	    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database_path, debouncer)
81	    return SyncService(engine, watcher, debouncer, config.full_sync_interval)

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:

33	        self._request_sync = request_sync

35	            database,

37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }

40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()

47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))

59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._retry_used = False
84	        self._stopped = False
85	        self._generation = 0
86	        self._callback_thread = None
87	
88	    def start(self) -> None:
89	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
90	        with self._condition:
91	            if self._stopped:
92	                return
93	
94	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
95	        self._generation += 1
96	        generation = self._generation
97	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
98	        timer.daemon = True
99	        self._timer = timer
100	        timer.start()
101	
102	    def notify(self) -> None:
103	        with self._condition:
104	            if self._stopped:
105	                return
106	            self._pending = True
107	            if not self._running:
108	                if self._timer is not None:
109	                    self._timer.cancel()
110	                else:
111	                    self._retry_used = False
112	                self._schedule_locked()
113	
114	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
115	        with self._condition:
116	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
117	                return
118	            self._timer = None
119	            self._pending = False
120	            self._running = True
121	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
122	
123	        retry = False
124	        try:
125	            retry = not bool(self._request())
126	        except Exception:
127	            _LOG.error("Debounced sync request failed")
128	        finally:
129	            with self._condition:
130	                self._running = False
131	                self._callback_thread = None
132	                should_retry = retry and not self._retry_used
133	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or should_retry):
134	                    if should_retry:
135	                        self._retry_used = True
136	                    self._pending = False
137	                    self._schedule_locked()
138	                elif not self._pending:
139	                    self._retry_used = False
140	                self._condition.notify_all()
141	
142	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
143	        with self._condition:
144	            if self._stopped:
145	                running = self._running
146	            else:
147	                self._stopped = True
148	                self._pending = False
149	                self._generation += 1
150	                timer = self._timer
151	                self._timer = None
152	                if timer is not None:
153	                    timer.cancel()
154	                running = self._running
155	
156	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
157	            with self._condition:
158	                while self._running:
159	                    self._condition.wait()

162	class DatabaseWatcher:
163	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
164	
165	    def __init__(
166	        self,
167	        database_path: Path,
168	        debounce: DebouncedSync,

172	        self._debounce = debounce
173	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
174	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
175	        self._observer = None
176	        self._observer_start_attempted = False
177	        self._started = False
178	        self._starting = False
179	        self._stopping = False
180	        self._stop_requested = False
181	
182	    @staticmethod
183	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer, start_attempted: bool) -> bool:
184	        errors = False
185	        try:
186	            observer.stop()
187	        except Exception:
188	            errors = True
189	            _LOG.error("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
190	        if start_attempted:

193	            except Exception:
194	                errors = True
195	                _LOG.error("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
196	
197	        try:

199	        except Exception:

201	            alive = True
202	            _LOG.error("Failed to check database watcher state after startup failure")
203	        if alive:
204	            _LOG.error("Database watcher remained alive after startup failure cleanup")
205	        return not errors and not alive
206	
207	    def start(self) -> None:
208	        with self._condition:
209	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
210	                self._condition.wait()
211	            if self._started:
212	                return
213	            self._starting = True
214	            self._stop_requested = False

216	        parent = self._database_path.parent
217	        try:

220	        except Exception:

120	
121	- 分配任务主位置和终态文件。
122	- 构造 Today/Upcoming 派生视图。
123	- 对任务进行稳定排序。
124	- 渲染任务区块、UUID 注释、元数据和 checklist。
125	- 清理文件名并解决路径冲突。
126	- 转义会破坏 Markdown 结构的单行内容。
127	
128	该模块不读取或写入文件，也不执行 Git。
129	
130	### `src/filesystem.py`
131	
132	协调期望文件集合与目标仓库当前状态：
133	
134	- 内容相同的文件不写入。
135	- 新内容先写入目标文件同目录下的临时文件，刷新后使用 `os.replace()` 原子替换。
136	- 删除不再存在的旧托管文件。
137	- 保留所有陌生文件。
138	- 返回新增、修改、删除的明确相对路径集合，供 Git 层使用。
139	
140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：

36	    import things
37	
38	    required = ("todos", "projects", "areas", "today", "upcoming")
39	    missing = [name for name in required if not callable(getattr(things, name, None))]
40	    if missing:
41	        raise AttributeError(
42	            "Things API is missing callable(s): " + ", ".join(missing)
43	        )
44	    return cast(ThingsAPI, things)
45	
46	
47	def discover_database_path(
48	    explicit: Optional[Path] = None, home: Optional[Path] = None
49	) -> Path:
50	    """Find the Things database, preferring an explicitly supplied path."""
51	    if explicit is not None:
52	        candidate = explicit.expanduser().resolve()
53	        if not candidate.is_file():
54	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Things database not found: {candidate}")
55	        return candidate
56	
57	    home_path = home or Path.home()
58	    root = home_path / MODERN_PATTERN
59	    modern = sorted(
60	        root.glob("ThingsData-*/Things Database.thingsdatabase/main.sqlite")
61	    )
62	    if modern:
63	        return modern[-1].resolve()
64	
65	    old = (home_path / OLD_RELATIVE).resolve()
66	    if old.is_file():
67	        return old
68	    raise FileNotFoundError("Things database was not found in known locations")
69	
70	
71	def _text(value: object, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
72	    """Return a text value while preserving missing/None optional fields."""
73	    if value is None:
74	        return default
75	    if isinstance(value, str):
76	        return value
77	    return str(value)
78	
79	
80	def _integer(value: object, default: int = 0) -> int:
81	    """Return an integer value, using a deterministic default when absent."""
82	    if value is None:
83	        return default
84	    if isinstance(value, bool):
85	        return int(value)
86	    try:
87	        return int(value)
88	    except (TypeError, ValueError):
89	        return default

92	def _normalize_checklist(items: object) -> Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...]:
93	    """Normalize checklist dictionaries and provide stable ordering."""
94	    if not isinstance(items, (list, tuple)):
95	        return ()
96	
97	    normalized: List[ChecklistItem] = []
98	    for item in items:
99	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
100	            continue
101	        uuid = _text(item.get("uuid"), "") or ""
102	        status = _text(item.get("status"), "incomplete") or "incomplete"
103	        title = _text(item.get("title"), "") or ""
104	        normalized.append(
105	            ChecklistItem(
106	                uuid=uuid,
107	                title=title,
108	                status=cast(str, status),
109	                stop_date=_text(item.get("stop_date")),
110	                created=_text(item.get("created")),
111	                modified=_text(item.get("modified")),
112	            )
113	        )
114	    normalized.sort(key=lambda item: (item.created or "", item.uuid))
115	    return tuple(normalized)

118	def _normalize_task(row: Dict[str, object]) -> TaskSnapshot:
119	    """Normalize one Things to-do dictionary into a domain snapshot."""
120	    status = _text(row.get("status"), "incomplete") or "incomplete"
121	    tags_value = row.get("tags")
122	    tags: List[str] = []
123	    if isinstance(tags_value, (list, tuple, set)):
124	        tags = [text for text in (_text(tag) for tag in tags_value) if text is not None]
125	    tags.sort()
126	
127	    return TaskSnapshot(
128	        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
129	        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
130	        status=cast(str, status),
131	        task_type=_text(row.get("type"), "to-do") or "to-do",
132	        start=_text(row.get("start")),
133	        area_uuid=_text(row.get("area")),
134	        area_title=_text(row.get("area_title")),
135	        project_uuid=_text(row.get("project")),
136	        project_title=_text(row.get("project_title")),
137	        heading_uuid=_text(row.get("heading")),
138	        heading_title=_text(row.get("heading_title")),
139	        notes=_text(row.get("notes")),
140	        tags=tuple(tags),
141	        checklist=_normalize_checklist(row.get("checklist")),
142	        start_date=_text(row.get("start_date")),
143	        deadline=_text(row.get("deadline")),
144	        reminder_time=_text(row.get("reminder_time")),
145	        stop_date=_text(row.get("stop_date")),
146	        created=_text(row.get("created")),
147	        modified=_text(row.get("modified")),
148	        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
149	        today_index=_integer(row.get("today_index")),
150	        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
151	    )
152	
153	
154	def _normalize_project(row: Dict[str, object]) -> ContainerSnapshot:
155	    """Normalize one Things project dictionary."""
156	    return ContainerSnapshot(
157	        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
158	        kind="project",
159	        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
160	        area_uuid=_text(row.get("area")),
161	        area_title=_text(row.get("area_title")),
162	        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
163	        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
164	    )
165	
166	
167	def _normalize_area(row: Dict[str, object]) -> ContainerSnapshot:
168	    """Normalize one Things area dictionary."""
169	    return ContainerSnapshot(
170	        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
171	        kind="area",
172	        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
173	        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
174	        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
175	    )
176	
177	
178	def _rows(value: object) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
179	    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
180	    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
181	        return []
182	    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]
183	
184	
185	def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
186	    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
187	    result: List[str] = []
188	    seen = set()
189	    for row in _rows(value):
190	        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
191	            continue
192	        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
193	        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
194	            seen.add(uuid)
195	            result.append(uuid)
196	    return tuple(result)
197	
198	
199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )
275

+"""Run the Things snapshot sync and own its background components."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from typing import Optional
+
+from .config import AppConfig
+from .git_ops import GitClient
+from .sync_engine import SyncEngine
+from .things_adapter import ThingsReader, discover_database_path, load_default_api
+from .watcher import DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class SyncService:
+    """Coordinate startup, periodic synchronization, and graceful shutdown."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        engine,
+        watcher,
+        debouncer,
+        full_sync_interval: float,
+        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.engine = engine
+        self.watcher = watcher
+        self.debouncer = debouncer
+        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
+        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
+        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    def run(self) -> None:
+        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
+        self.engine.sync()
+        try:
+            with self._stop_lock:
+                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
+                    return
+                self.watcher.start()
+                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
+                    return

 class SyncEngine:
     def __init__(
         self,
         config,
         reader: SnapshotReader,
         git_client: GitSyncClient,
         renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
         reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
     ) -> None:
         self.config = config
         self.reader = reader
         self.git_client = git_client
         self.renderer = renderer
         self.reconciler = reconciler
         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 
     def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
         status["stage"] = "reader"
         snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
         status["stage"] = "renderer"
         rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
         status["stage"] = "reconciler"
         changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
         status["changes"] = changes
         status["stage"] = "git"
         committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
             changes,
             auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
             auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
             remote=self.config.git_remote,
             branch=self.config.git_branch,
         )
         status["committed"] = committed
         status["pushed"] = pushed
         return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
 
     @staticmethod
     def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
         try:
             changes = status["changes"]
             counts = (
                 (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                 if changes is not None
                 else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
             )
             committed = status["committed"]
             pushed = status["pushed"]
             if committed is None:
                 committed = "not executed"
             if pushed is None:
                 pushed = "not executed"
             duration = time.monotonic() - started
             error = status["error"]
             if error is None:
                 _LOG.info(
                     "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
                 )
             else:
                 _LOG.error(
-                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
+                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
                     status["stage"],
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
-                    error,
                 )
         except BaseException:
             # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
             pass
 
     def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
         status = {
             "stage": "reader",
             "changes": None,
             "committed": None,
             "pushed": None,
             "error": None,
         }
         try:
             return self._sync_locked(status)
         except BaseException as error:
             status["error"] = error
             raise
         finally:
             try:
                 self._log_sync(started, status)
             finally:
                 self._lock.release()
 
     def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
         started = time.monotonic()
         self._lock.acquire()
         return self._run_locked(started)
 
     def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
         started = time.monotonic()
         if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
             return False
         self._run_locked(started)
         return True

17	class SyncService:

19	
20	    def __init__(
21	        self,
22	        engine,
23	        watcher,
24	        debouncer,
25	        full_sync_interval: float,
26	        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,

28	        self.engine = engine
29	        self.watcher = watcher
30	        self.debouncer = debouncer
31	        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
32	        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
33	        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
34	        self._stop_requested = False
35	
36	    def run(self) -> None:
37	        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
38	        self.engine.sync()
39	        try:
40	            with self._stop_lock:
41	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
42	                    return
43	                self.watcher.start()
44	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
45	                    return
46	            while not self.stop_event.wait(self.full_sync_interval):
47	                with self._stop_lock:
48	                    if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
49	                        break

54	        finally:

59	            try:

61	            except Exception:

63

76	        self._request = request

79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()

156	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
157	
158	### Git 和分支
159	
160	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
161	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
162	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
163	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
164	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
165	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
166	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
167	
168	### SDD 流程
169	
170	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
171	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
172	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
173	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
174	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
175	- 未完成 Task 10 review 前不能开始 Task 11。
176	
177	### Things3 只读边界
178	
179	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
180	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
181	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
182	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
183	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
184	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
185	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
186	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
187	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
188	
189	### 文件系统和路径
190	
191	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
192	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
193	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
194	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
195	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
196	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
197	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
198	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
199	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
200	
201	### Git 实现
202	
203	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
204	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
205	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
206	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
207	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
208	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。
209	
210	### 日志隐私（本次会话反复踩到）
211	
212	- 所有错误日志必须使用固定消息，不得输出异常文本或 traceback。

17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):

19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

1	"""Run the Things snapshot sync and own its background components."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	from typing import Optional
6	
7	from .config import AppConfig
8	from .git_ops import GitClient
9	from .sync_engine import SyncEngine
10	from .things_adapter import ThingsReader, discover_database_path, load_default_api
11	from .watcher import DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
12	
13	
14	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SyncService:
18	    """Coordinate startup, periodic synchronization, and graceful shutdown."""
19	
20	    def __init__(
21	        self,
22	        engine,
23	        watcher,
24	        debouncer,
25	        full_sync_interval: float,
26	        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,
27	    ) -> None:
28	        self.engine = engine
29	        self.watcher = watcher
30	        self.debouncer = debouncer
31	        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
32	        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
33	        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
34	        self._stop_requested = False
35	
36	    def run(self) -> None:
37	        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
38	        self.engine.sync()
39	        try:
40	            with self._stop_lock:
41	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
42	                    return
43	                self.watcher.start()
44	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
45	                    return
46	            while not self.stop_event.wait(self.full_sync_interval):
47	                with self._stop_lock:
48	                    if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
49	                        break
50	                    try:
51	                        self.engine.sync()
52	                    except Exception:
53	                        logger.error("Scheduled full sync failed")
54	        finally:
55	            try:
56	                self.watcher.stop()
57	            except Exception:
58	                logger.error("Watcher cleanup failed")
59	            try:
60	                self.debouncer.stop(wait=True)
61	            except Exception:
62	                logger.error("Debouncer cleanup failed")
63	
64	    def stop(self) -> None:
65	        """Request shutdown once; repeated requests have no additional effect."""
66	        with self._stop_lock:
67	            if self._stop_requested:
68	                return
69	            self._stop_requested = True
70	            self.stop_event.set()
71	
72	
73	def build_service(config: AppConfig) -> SyncService:
74	    """Construct the complete service graph from application configuration."""
75	    database_path = discover_database_path(config.things_db)
76	    reader = ThingsReader(load_default_api(), database_path)
77	    git_client = GitClient(config.repo_path, timeout=config.git_timeout_seconds)
78	    engine = SyncEngine(config, reader, git_client)
79	    debouncer = DebouncedSync(engine.sync_if_idle, config.watch_debounce_seconds)
80	    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database_path, debouncer)
81	    return SyncService(engine, watcher, debouncer, config.full_sync_interval)
82

2	
3	import logging
4	import signal
5	from pathlib import Path
6	
7	try:
8	    import dotenv
9	except ImportError:  # Keep the entry point importable before dependencies are installed.
10	    class _Dotenv:
11	        @staticmethod
12	        def load_dotenv() -> None:
13	            return None
14	
15	    dotenv = _Dotenv()
16	
17	from src.config import AppConfig
18	from src.service import build_service
19	from src.utils import setup_logging
20	
21	
22	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
23	
24	# Module-level handle so signal handlers can reach the service even before it is
25	# constructed, and so tests can inject a fake service without touching signal state.
26	service_holder: dict = {}
27	
28	
29	def main() -> int:
30	    """Load configuration, run the service, and return a process exit code."""
31	    try:
32	        dotenv.load_dotenv()
33	        config = AppConfig.from_env()
34	    except Exception:
35	        logger.error("Configuration failed")
36	        return 2
37	
38	    try:
39	        setup_logging(
40	            Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "logs",
41	            config.log_level,
42	            config.log_max_bytes,
43	            config.log_backup_count,
44	        )
45	        service = build_service(config)
46	        service_holder["service"] = service
47	
48	        def handle_signal(signum, frame) -> None:
49	            del signum, frame
50	            service_holder.get("service").stop()
51	            logger.info("Shutdown requested")
52	
53	        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_signal)
54	        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_signal)
55	        service.run()
56	    except Exception:
57	        logger.error("Service failed")
58	        return 1
59	    return 0
60	
61	
62	if __name__ == "__main__":
63	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP Implementation Plan
2	
3	> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4	
5	**Goal:** 构建一个 macOS 后台服务，只读监听 Things3 数据库，把完整任务快照确定性导出为 Markdown，并按配置自动提交和推送到 Git 仓库。
6	
7	**Architecture:** 所有触发源都调用同一条快照流水线：只读适配器规范化 Things 字典，纯渲染器生成期望文件和容器映射，文件协调器原子收敛磁盘状态，Git 层只暂存明确路径。服务层用防抖队列串行化数据库事件、启动同步和定时同步，并在信号退出时等待当前操作结束。
8	
9	**Tech Stack:** Python 3.9+、`things.py>=1.0.1,<2`、`watchdog>=2.1,<7`、`python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`、标准库 `dataclasses`/`pathlib`/`sqlite3`/`subprocess`/`threading`/`logging`、pytest。
10	
11	## Global Constraints
12	
13	- 运行平台为 macOS，Python 最低版本为 3.9。
14	- 运行时依赖必须限定为 `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`、`watchdog>=2.1,<7`、`python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`；测试依赖在 `requirements-dev.txt` 中声明。
15	- Things 数据库只能通过读取接口访问；业务代码不得导入或调用 `complete()`，不得构造 `update` 或 `update-project` URL。
16	- 所有文件路径使用 `pathlib.Path`；所有 Git 命令使用带超时的 `subprocess.run()`。
17	- 数据库读取失败后间隔 10 秒重试，最多 3 次；完整快照成功前不得修改目标仓库。
18	- 禁止使用 `git add .`；只暂存文件协调器返回的明确相对路径。
19	- 同步器只删除带生成标识的已知托管文件；陌生文件必须保留并记录警告。
20	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 必须同时满足 `AUTO_COMMIT=true`。
21	- 不自动 pull、merge、rebase 或解决远端冲突。
22	- 输出中不包含参考库未公开的优先级、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
23	- 现有 `.gitignore` 和 `docs/CHANGELOG.md` 是用户在本计划开始前已暂存的改动。每个实施提交必须使用 `git commit --only -- <本任务文件>`，不得修改或把它们带入功能提交。
24	- 本地 `things.py/` 已被忽略，只作为 API 源码和 SQLite 测试 fixture 参考，不作为主项目源码提交。

198	```python
199	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
200	from pathlib import Path
201	from types import MappingProxyType
202	from typing import Literal, Mapping, Optional, Tuple
203	
204	TaskStatus = Literal["incomplete", "completed", "canceled"]
205	ContainerKind = Literal["project", "area"]
206	ChangeKind = Literal["added", "modified", "deleted"]
207	
208	_VALID_STATUSES = {"incomplete", "completed", "canceled"}
209	
210	
211	@dataclass(frozen=True)
212	class ChecklistItem:
213	    uuid: str
214	    title: str
215	    status: TaskStatus
216	    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
217	    created: Optional[str] = None
218	    modified: Optional[str] = None
219	
220	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
221	        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
222	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported checklist status: {self.status}")
223	
224	
225	@dataclass(frozen=True)
226	class TaskSnapshot:
227	    uuid: str
228	    title: str
229	    status: TaskStatus
230	    task_type: str = "to-do"
231	    start: Optional[str] = None
232	    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
233	    area_title: Optional[str] = None
234	    project_uuid: Optional[str] = None
235	    project_title: Optional[str] = None
236	    heading_uuid: Optional[str] = None
237	    heading_title: Optional[str] = None
238	    notes: Optional[str] = None
239	    tags: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
240	    checklist: Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
241	    start_date: Optional[str] = None
242	    deadline: Optional[str] = None
243	    reminder_time: Optional[str] = None
244	    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
245	    created: Optional[str] = None
246	    modified: Optional[str] = None
247	    index: int = 0
248	    today_index: int = 0
249	    trashed: bool = False
250	
251	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
252	        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
253	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task status: {self.status}")
254	        if self.task_type != "to-do":
255	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task type: {self.task_type}")
256	
257	
258	@dataclass(frozen=True)
259	class ContainerSnapshot:
260	    uuid: str
261	    kind: ContainerKind
262	    title: str
263	    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
264	    area_title: Optional[str] = None
265	    index: int = 0
266	    trashed: bool = False
267	
268	
269	@dataclass(frozen=True)
270	class ThingsSnapshot:
271	    tasks: Tuple[TaskSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
272	    projects: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
273	    areas: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
274	    today_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
275	    upcoming_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
276	
277	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
278	        object.__setattr__(self, "tasks", tuple(self.tasks))
279	        object.__setattr__(self, "projects", tuple(self.projects))
280	        object.__setattr__(self, "areas", tuple(self.areas))
281	        object.__setattr__(self, "today_uuids", tuple(self.today_uuids))
282	        object.__setattr__(self, "upcoming_uuids", tuple(self.upcoming_uuids))
283	        task_ids = [task.uuid for task in self.tasks]
284	        container_ids = [container.uuid for container in self.projects + self.areas]
285	        if len(task_ids) != len(set(task_ids)):
286	            raise ValueError("Duplicate task UUID in snapshot")
287	        if len(container_ids) != len(set(container_ids)):
288	            raise ValueError("Duplicate container UUID in snapshot")
289	
290	
291	@dataclass(frozen=True)
292	class ContainerPath:
293	    uuid: str
294	    kind: ContainerKind
295	    relative_dir: Path
296	
297	
298	@dataclass(frozen=True)
299	class RenderedSnapshot:
300	    files: Mapping[Path, str]
301	    containers: Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]
302	
303	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
304	        object.__setattr__(self, "files", MappingProxyType(dict(self.files)))
305	        object.__setattr__(self, "containers", tuple(self.containers))
306	
307	
308	@dataclass(frozen=True)
309	class ChangeSet:
310	    added: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
311	    modified: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
312	    deleted: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
313	    git_paths: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
314	
315	    @property
316	    def paths(self) -> Tuple[Path, ...]:
317	        return tuple(sorted(set(self.added + self.modified + self.deleted)))
318	
319	    @property
320	    def changed(self) -> bool:
321	        return bool(self.paths)
322	
323	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
324	        object.__setattr__(self, "added", tuple(sorted(set(self.added))))
325	        object.__setattr__(self, "modified", tuple(sorted(set(self.modified))))
326	        object.__setattr__(self, "deleted", tuple(sorted(set(self.deleted))))
327	        if self.git_paths:
328	            object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", tuple(sorted(set(self.git_paths))))
329	        elif self.paths:
330	            object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", self.paths)
331	
332	
333	@dataclass(frozen=True)
334	class SyncResult:
335	    changes: ChangeSet
336	    committed: bool = False
337	    pushed: bool = False
338	```
339	
340	Every snapshot `__post_init__` must normalize externally supplied lists to tuples. `RenderedSnapshot` must copy `files` and wrap that copy in `MappingProxyType`; a frozen dataclass alone does not prevent a caller from mutating a supplied dict. `ThingsSnapshot` rejects duplicate container UUIDs across projects and areas as well as duplicate task UUIDs. `ChangeSet.__post_init__` must normalize all explicit path sequences to sorted unique tuples and derive `git_paths` from `paths` only when no historical pathspec was supplied.

Output:

```
1	# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP 设计
2	
3	## 背景
4	
5	本项目需要在 macOS 上只读监听 Things3 数据库，将任务导出为结构化 Markdown，并通过 Git 自动提交和推送到用户已配置的远端仓库。
6	
7	仓库中的 `Agent.md` 描述了完整产品愿景，但当前主项目尚无实现。内嵌的 `things.py` 1.0.1 参考库公开的是返回稀疏字典的函数接口，而不是 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 类；它也不提供优先级、Evening 等字段。因此 MVP 以参考库的真实只读数据为准，不输出无法可靠获得的字段。
8	
9	## 目标
10	
11	MVP 必须做到：
12	
13	1. 启动时读取完整 Things3 快照并同步 Markdown。
14	2. 监听 Things3 SQLite 数据库及其 WAL/SHM 变化，经防抖后再次同步。
15	3. 使用确定性渲染和原子文件替换，使内容未变化时不写磁盘、不产生 Git diff。
16	4. 自动暂存同步器实际变更的明确路径，按配置提交并推送。
17	5. 定时运行同一套完整快照同步，修复遗漏或漂移。
18	6. 捕获 `SIGINT` 和 `SIGTERM`，停止接收新工作并等待当前同步结束。
19	7. 提供安装、配置、前台运行与 launchd 部署文档和自动化测试。
20	
21	## 非目标
22	
23	MVP 不包括：
24	
25	- 从 Markdown 写回 Things3。
26	- Things 附件同步。
27	- 自动 merge、rebase 或解决 Git 冲突。
28	- 从底层数据库私有字段推导 `things.py` 未公开的优先级、Evening 或重复规则。
29	- Web 管理界面和性能监控面板。
30	- 对真实 GitHub 远端或真实用户 Things 数据库执行自动化集成测试。
31	
32	## 关键决策
33	
34	### 同步策略
35	
36	采用“防抖后的确定性完整快照”策略，而不是在 MVP 中维护独立的增量写入路径。
37	
38	每次同步均执行：
39	
40	```text
41	读取完整只读快照
42	  -> 规范化数据
43	  -> 渲染期望文件集合
44	  -> 原子协调磁盘
45	  -> 明确暂存变更路径
46	  -> 可选提交
47	  -> 可选推送
48	```
49	
50	SQLite 文件变化事件无法直接指出发生变化的任务。即使做 UUID 级增量更新，也必须先读取新快照做差异比较。完整快照渲染可同时正确处理任务移动、删除、容器重命名和 Today/Upcoming 派生视图，并让启动同步、监听同步和定时校验复用同一条代码路径。
51	
52	完整快照不意味着无条件重写文件。文件协调器先比较字节内容，只替换发生变化的文件。由此，单个标题变化通常只产生对应标题行的 Git diff。
53	
54	### 文件所有权
55	
56	同步器完全管理它生成的 Markdown 内容，但删除操作采用保守边界：
57	
58	- 每个生成文件包含稳定的生成标识。
59	- 仅删除位于已知导出路径中、带生成标识且不再属于期望快照的文件。
60	- 未带生成标识的陌生文件始终保留并记录警告。
61	- 同步器不使用笼统的目录递归删除处理未知内容。
62	
63	该规则兼顾确定性全量协调和用户文件保护。
64	
65	### 主位置与派生视图
66	
67	每个任务只有一个主位置，优先级如下：
68	
69	1. 所属 Project。
70	2. 所属 Area。
71	3. `Inbox`、`Anytime` 或 `Someday` 顶层列表。
72	
73	`Today.md` 和 `Upcoming.md` 是派生视图，允许重复展示已有主位置的任务。Today 的语义直接复用 `things.today()`，不根据单一 `start` 字段自行重建。
74	
75	## 架构
76	
77	### `src/config.py`
78	
79	负责读取和验证 `.env` 配置，向其他模块提供类型化配置对象。配置包括：
80	
81	- `REPO_PATH`：目标 Git 仓库绝对路径。
82	- `THINGSDB`：可选数据库覆盖路径；缺省时使用 `things.py` 自带的路径发现。
83	- `LOG_LEVEL`、`LOG_MAX_BYTES`、`LOG_BACKUP_COUNT`。
84	- `WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS`。
85	- `FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL`。
86	- `AUTO_COMMIT`、`AUTO_PUSH`。
87	- `GIT_REMOTE`、`GIT_BRANCH`。
88	- Git 子进程超时。
89	
90	约束：`AUTO_PUSH=true` 时必须启用 `AUTO_COMMIT`。目标路径必须存在且为 Git 工作树。敏感配置不写入日志。
91	
92	### `src/models.py`
93	
94	定义项目内部不可变数据模型，将外部稀疏字典与渲染逻辑隔离。主要实体为：
95	
96	- `TaskSnapshot`
97	- `ChecklistItem`
98	- `ContainerSnapshot`
99	- `ThingsSnapshot`
100	
101	可选字段有明确的 `None` 或空集合默认值。状态只接受 `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled`；类型只接受 MVP 用到的 `to-do`、`project`、`heading`。
102	
103	### `src/things_adapter.py`
104	
105	只使用 `things` 的读取接口：`tasks()`、`areas()`、`today()`、`upcoming()` 等，并把结果规范化为内部模型。
106	
107	该模块不导入或调用 `complete()`，也不构造 `update`/`update-project` URL。数据库访问失败后等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次。只有读取并规范化完整快照成功后才向调用方返回结果。
108	
109	数据库定位遵循：
110	
111	1. 显式 `THINGSDB`。
112	2. `things.py` 对现代 `ThingsData-*` 路径的发现。
113	3. 参考库的旧路径回退。
114	
115	### `src/renderer.py`
116	
117	输入一个 `ThingsSnapshot`，输出 `dict[Path, str]`，键是相对于目标仓库的安全路径，值是确定性 UTF-8 Markdown 内容。
118	
119	职责包括：
120	
121	- 分配任务主位置和终态文件。
122	- 构造 Today/Upcoming 派生视图。
123	- 对任务进行稳定排序。
124	- 渲染任务区块、UUID 注释、元数据和 checklist。
125	- 清理文件名并解决路径冲突。
126	- 转义会破坏 Markdown 结构的单行内容。
127	
128	该模块不读取或写入文件，也不执行 Git。
129	
130	### `src/filesystem.py`
131	
132	协调期望文件集合与目标仓库当前状态：
133	
134	- 内容相同的文件不写入。
135	- 新内容先写入目标文件同目录下的临时文件，刷新后使用 `os.replace()` 原子替换。
136	- 删除不再存在的旧托管文件。
137	- 保留所有陌生文件。
138	- 返回新增、修改、删除的明确相对路径集合，供 Git 层使用。
139	
140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302	
303	## 配置与部署
304	
305	项目提供：
306	
307	- `.env.example`
308	- `requirements.txt`
309	- `setup.py` 交互式配置脚本
310	- `generate_launchd.py`
311	- `main.py`
312	- README 安装和运维说明
313	
314	依赖基线：
315	
316	- Python 3.9+
317	- `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`
318	- `watchdog>=2.1,<7`
319	- `python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`
320	
321	launchd 生成器在项目内生成 plist 预览。用户通过明确的 setup 步骤安装到 `~/Library/LaunchAgents`，普通同步进程不修改系统 launchd 配置。
322	
323	## 测试策略
324	
325	### 单元测试
326	
327	`tests/test_things_adapter.py`：
328	
329	- 使用内嵌参考库的 SQLite fixture 或等价测试数据库，通过 `THINGSDB` 注入。

341	- 稳定排序和确定性输出。
342	
343	`tests/test_filesystem.py`：
344	
345	- 无变化不写入。
346	- 新增、原子修改、删除旧托管文件。
347	- 保留陌生文件。
348	- 容器重命名、归档及含陌生文件时的保守行为。
349	- 中途失败后下一轮收敛。
350	
351	`tests/test_git_ops.py`：

365	
366	### 集成测试
367	
368	在临时目录创建 Git 仓库，使用测试数据库完成：

377

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]

112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,

128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()

131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)

137	        started = time.monotonic()

17	class SyncService:
18	    """Coordinate startup, periodic synchronization, and graceful shutdown."""
19	
20	    def __init__(
21	        self,
22	        engine,
23	        watcher,
24	        debouncer,
25	        full_sync_interval: float,
26	        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,
27	    ) -> None:
28	        self.engine = engine
29	        self.watcher = watcher
30	        self.debouncer = debouncer
31	        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
32	        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
33	        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
34	        self._stop_requested = False
35	
36	    def run(self) -> None:
37	        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
38	        self.engine.sync()
39	        try:
40	            with self._stop_lock:
41	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
42	                    return
43	                self.watcher.start()
44	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
45	                    return
46	            while not self.stop_event.wait(self.full_sync_interval):
47	                with self._stop_lock:
48	                    if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
49	                        break
50	                    try:
51	                        self.engine.sync()
52	                    except Exception:
53	                        logger.error("Scheduled full sync failed")
54	        finally:
55	            try:
56	                self.watcher.stop()
57	            except Exception:

59	            try:
60	                self.debouncer.stop(wait=True)
61	            except Exception:
62	                logger.error("Debouncer cleanup failed")
63

65	        """Request shutdown once; repeated requests have no additional effect."""
66	        with self._stop_lock:
67	            if self._stop_requested:
68	                return
69	            self._stop_requested = True
70	            self.stop_event.set()

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

24	    @classmethod
25	    def from_env(cls, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, *, git_runner: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess] = subprocess.run) -> "AppConfig":
26	        values = os.environ if env is None else env
27	        raw_repo = values.get("REPO_PATH", "").strip()
28	        if not raw_repo: raise ValueError("REPO_PATH is required")
29	        repo = Path(raw_repo).expanduser().resolve()
30	        if not repo.exists() or not repo.is_dir(): raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be an existing directory: {repo}")
31	        def number(name, default, cast=float, positive=False, nonnegative=False):
32	            try: result = cast(values.get(name, str(default)))
33	            except (TypeError, ValueError): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be numeric")
34	            if positive and result <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
35	            if nonnegative and result < 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
36	            return result

38	        level = values.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO").strip().upper()
