122	        if result.returncode != 0 and not (
123	            args[:3] == ["diff", "--cached", "--quiet"] and result.returncode == 1
124	        ) and not (
125	            args[:3] == ["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet"] and result.returncode == 1
126	        ):
127	            _LOG.error(
128	                "Git command failed (%s): %s",
129	                _redact_credentials(" ".join(command)),
130	                _redact_credentials(result.stderr or ""),
131	            )
132	        return result
133	
134	    def stage(self, paths: Sequence[Path], *, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> bool:
135	        """Stage only the supplied paths and report whether they have a staged diff."""
136	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
137	        if not pathspecs:
138	            return False
139	        staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
140	        if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
141	            return False
142	        diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
143	        if diff is None:
144	            return False
145	        if diff.returncode == 1:
146	            return True
147	        if diff.returncode == 0:
148	            return False
149	        return False
150	
151	    def _isolated_commit(self, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime]) -> bool:
152	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_FAILURE
153	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
154	        if not pathspecs:
155	            self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
156	            return False
157	        try:
158	            descriptor, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="things3-sync-index-")
159	        except OSError as error:
160	            _LOG.error("Could not initialize temporary Git index: %s", error)
161	            return False
162	        os.close(descriptor)
163	        index_path = Path(index_name)
164	        try:
165	            index_path.unlink()
166	            index_env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
167	            seeded = self._run(["read-tree", "HEAD"], index_env)
168	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:
169	                return False
170	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
174	            if diff is None:
175	                return False
176	            if diff.returncode == 0:
177	                self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
178	                return False
179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)
265

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,

35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:
42	            token.extend("x{:02x}".format(byte) for byte in character.encode("utf-8"))
43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"

46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix

56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths

87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99

108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():

128

137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix

139	            )

141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:

149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []

153	    for container in active:

156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1

160	        else:

162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1

167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))

194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix

200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")

220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected

235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)

1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:

104

106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"

109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

156	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
157	
158	### Git 和分支
159	
160	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
161	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
162	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
163	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
164	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
165	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
166	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
167	
168	### SDD 流程
169	
170	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
171	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
172	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
173	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
174	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
175	- 未完成 Task 10 review 前不能开始 Task 11。
176	
177	### Things3 只读边界
178	
179	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
180	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
181	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
182	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
183	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
184	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
185	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
186	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
187	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
188	
189	### 文件系统和路径
190	
191	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
192	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
193	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
194	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
195	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
196	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
197	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
198	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
199	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
200	
201	### Git 实现
202	
203	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
204	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
205	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
206	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
207	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
208	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。
209	
210	### 日志隐私（本次会话反复踩到）
211	
212	- 所有错误日志必须使用固定消息，不得输出异常文本或 traceback。
213	- 任何包含数据库路径、仓库路径、token、auth-token、password 的异常消息都必须在日志外出现。
214	- 测试中要用含 `password=` 或 `/private/TARGET/...` 的异常做回归断言，证明敏感文本不在日志中。
215	- `logger.exception(...)` 在 watcher/service 代码中一律不用；用 `logger.error("固定消息")`。
216	
217	### 测试和环境
218	
219	- 优先使用 `/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python`，系统 Python 可能没有 pytest。
220	- 推荐命令：
221	```bash
222	/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
223	```
224	- 如果执行根目录 broad `pytest`，可能误收集被忽略的 `things.py/tests`，出现 `ModuleNotFoundError: tests.test_things`；这不是项目 `tests/` 套件失败。报告中要区分两者。
225	- 测试时避免产生不必要的 bytecode/cache；可用 `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider ...`。
226	- 每次任务的报告要记录 RED/GREEN 命令、精确输出和未执行的检查。
227	
228	### Workflow / 子代理
229	
230	- 本项目使用 Workflow 工具派发 implementer 与独立 reviewer，脚本必须是纯 JavaScript，不能用 TypeScript 语法。
231	- 脚本内的 agent prompt 如果包含反引号等特殊字符，会被解析器拒绝；用普通引号或拆分字符串。
232	- review agent 与 implementer 都可能因 `403 Insufficient account balance`、`504 openai_error` 或响应流解码错误而失败。失败时不要虚构结论，记录真实原因后重试，必要时改用更低成本模型（haiku）。
233	- 不要把实现代理自测当正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
234	
235	## 7. 继续开发的启动步骤
236	
237	新对话应按以下顺序操作：
238	
239	1. 阅读本文件。
240	2. 阅读 `Agent.md`、设计规格、实施计划和 `.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp/progress.md`。
241	3. 执行 `git status --short`、`git log --oneline --decorate -10`，确认当前 HEAD 与未提交文件；不要清理任何既有状态。

244	6. 后续每个任务严格执行 brief -> BASE -> implementer -> report -> review -> fix/re-review -> ledger 的顺序。
245	
246	本交接文件不属于任何功能提交，除非用户明确要求提交它。

"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""

import logging
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple

from .filesystem import reconcile
from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
from .renderer import render_snapshot


_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
        ...


class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
    def sync(
        self,
        changes: ChangeSet,
        auto_commit: bool,
        auto_push: bool,
        remote: str,
        branch: str,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
        ...


class SyncEngine:
    def __init__(
        self,
        config,
        reader: SnapshotReader,
        git_client: GitSyncClient,
        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.reader = reader
        self.git_client = git_client
        self.renderer = renderer
        self.reconciler = reconciler
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
        status["stage"] = "reader"
        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
        status["stage"] = "renderer"
        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
        status["changes"] = changes
        status["stage"] = "git"
        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
            changes,
            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
            remote=self.config.git_remote,
            branch=self.config.git_branch,
        )
        status["committed"] = committed
        status["pushed"] = pushed
        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)

    @staticmethod
    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
        try:
            changes = status["changes"]
            counts = (
                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                if changes is not None
                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
            )
            committed = status["committed"]
            pushed = status["pushed"]
            if committed is None:
                committed = "not executed"
            if pushed is None:
                pushed = "not executed"
            duration = time.monotonic() - started
            error = status["error"]
            if error is None:
                _LOG.info(
                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                )
            else:
                _LOG.error(
                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
                    status["stage"],
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                    error,
                )
        except BaseException:
            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
            pass

    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
        status = {
            "stage": "reader",
            "changes": None,
            "committed": None,
            "pushed": None,
            "error": None,
        }
        try:
            return self._sync_locked(status)
        except BaseException as error:
            status["error"] = error
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                self._log_sync(started, status)
            finally:
                self._lock.release()

    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
        started = time.monotonic()
        self._lock.acquire()
        return self._run_locked(started)

    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
        started = time.monotonic()
        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return False
        self._run_locked(started)
        return True

### 🤖 Assistant · 2026-09-07 23:57:40

Found 2 concrete reuse issues:

1. `src/watcher.py:183`  
   **Summary:** Startup-failure cleanup duplicates the observer stop/join/aliveness policy already implemented by `DatabaseWatcher.stop()`.  
   **Failure scenario:** If the join timeout or cleanup semantics change in `stop()` but not `_cleanup_after_start_failure()`, startup failures can leave watcher threads alive or produce inconsistent retry behavior.

2. `src/watcher.py:23`  
   **Summary:** Path normalization is duplicated in `watcher.py`, while `config.py` and `things_adapter.py` independently apply the same `expanduser().resolve()` policy.  
   **Failure scenario:** If path handling changes in one module, the reader and watcher may normalize the database path differently, causing filesystem events to be missed and syncs not to trigger.

28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
142	
```

1	"""Run the Things snapshot sync and own its background components."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	from typing import Optional
6	
7	from .config import AppConfig
8	from .git_ops import GitClient
9	from .sync_engine import SyncEngine
10	from .things_adapter import ThingsReader, discover_database_path, load_default_api
11	from .watcher import DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
12	
13	
14	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SyncService:
18	    """Coordinate startup, periodic synchronization, and graceful shutdown."""
19	
20	    def __init__(
21	        self,
22	        engine,
23	        watcher,
24	        debouncer,
25	        full_sync_interval: float,
26	        stop_event: Optional[object] = None,
27	    ) -> None:
28	        self.engine = engine
29	        self.watcher = watcher
30	        self.debouncer = debouncer
31	        self.full_sync_interval = full_sync_interval
32	        self.stop_event = stop_event if stop_event is not None else threading.Event()
33	        self._stop_lock = threading.RLock()
34	        self._stop_requested = False
35	
36	    def run(self) -> None:
37	        """Perform the initial sync, then run periodic full syncs until stopped."""
38	        self.engine.sync()
39	        try:
40	            with self._stop_lock:
41	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
42	                    return
43	                self.watcher.start()
44	                if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
45	                    return
46	            while not self.stop_event.wait(self.full_sync_interval):
47	                with self._stop_lock:
48	                    if self._stop_requested or self.stop_event.is_set():
49	                        break
50	                    try:
51	                        self.engine.sync()
52	                    except Exception:
53	                        logger.error("Scheduled full sync failed")
54	        finally:
55	            try:
56	                self.watcher.stop()
57	            except Exception:
58	                logger.error("Watcher cleanup failed")
59	            try:
60	                self.debouncer.stop(wait=True)
61	            except Exception:
62	                logger.error("Debouncer cleanup failed")
63	
64	    def stop(self) -> None:
65	        """Request shutdown once; repeated requests have no additional effect."""
66	        with self._stop_lock:
67	            if self._stop_requested:
68	                return
69	            self._stop_requested = True
70	            self.stop_event.set()
71	
72	
73	def build_service(config: AppConfig) -> SyncService:
74	    """Construct the complete service graph from application configuration."""
75	    database_path = discover_database_path(config.things_db)
76	    reader = ThingsReader(load_default_api(), database_path)
77	    git_client = GitClient(config.repo_path, timeout=config.git_timeout_seconds)
78	    engine = SyncEngine(config, reader, git_client)
79	    debouncer = DebouncedSync(engine.sync_if_idle, config.watch_debounce_seconds)
80	    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database_path, debouncer)
81	    return SyncService(engine, watcher, debouncer, config.full_sync_interval)

8	try:

23	def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
24	    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51	
52	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,
58	            (
59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._retry_used = False
84	        self._stopped = False
85	        self._generation = 0
86	        self._callback_thread = None
87	
88	    def start(self) -> None:
89	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
90	        with self._condition:
91	            if self._stopped:
92	                return
93	
94	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
95	        self._generation += 1
96	        generation = self._generation
97	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
98	        timer.daemon = True
99	        self._timer = timer
100	        timer.start()
101	
102	    def notify(self) -> None:
103	        with self._condition:
104	            if self._stopped:
105	                return
106	            self._pending = True
107	            if not self._running:
108	                if self._timer is not None:
109	                    self._timer.cancel()
110	                else:
111	                    self._retry_used = False
112	                self._schedule_locked()
113	
114	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
115	        with self._condition:
116	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
117	                return
118	            self._timer = None
119	            self._pending = False
120	            self._running = True
121	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
122	
123	        retry = False
124	        try:
125	            retry = not bool(self._request())
126	        except Exception:
127	            _LOG.error("Debounced sync request failed")
128	        finally:
129	            with self._condition:
130	                self._running = False
131	                self._callback_thread = None
132	                should_retry = retry and not self._retry_used
133	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or should_retry):
134	                    if should_retry:
135	                        self._retry_used = True
136	                    self._pending = False
137	                    self._schedule_locked()
138	                elif not self._pending:
139	                    self._retry_used = False
140	                self._condition.notify_all()
141	
142	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
143	        with self._condition:
144	            if self._stopped:
145	                running = self._running
146	            else:
147	                self._stopped = True
148	                self._pending = False
149	                self._generation += 1
150	                timer = self._timer
151	                self._timer = None
152	                if timer is not None:
153	                    timer.cancel()
154	                running = self._running
155	
156	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
157	            with self._condition:
158	                while self._running:
159	                    self._condition.wait()

162	class DatabaseWatcher:
163	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
164	
165	    def __init__(
166	        self,

172	        self._debounce = debounce
173	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
174	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
175	        self._observer = None
176	        self._observer_start_attempted = False
177	        self._started = False
178	        self._starting = False
179	        self._stopping = False
180	        self._stop_requested = False
181	
182	    @staticmethod
183	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer, start_attempted: bool) -> bool:
184	        errors = False
185	        try:
186	            observer.stop()
187	        except Exception:
188	            errors = True

190	        if start_attempted:

197	        try:

199	        except Exception:

202	            _LOG.error("Failed to check database watcher state after startup failure")
203	        if alive:

205	        return not errors and not alive

213	            self._starting = True

 class SyncEngine:
     def __init__(
         self,
         config,
         reader: SnapshotReader,
         git_client: GitSyncClient,
         renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
         reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
     ) -> None:
         self.config = config
         self.reader = reader
         self.git_client = git_client
         self.renderer = renderer
         self.reconciler = reconciler
         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 
     def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
         status["stage"] = "reader"
         snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
         status["stage"] = "renderer"
         rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
         status["stage"] = "reconciler"
         changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
         status["changes"] = changes
         status["stage"] = "git"
         committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
             changes,
             auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
             auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
             remote=self.config.git_remote,
             branch=self.config.git_branch,
         )
         status["committed"] = committed
         status["pushed"] = pushed
         return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
 
     @staticmethod
     def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
         try:
             changes = status["changes"]
             counts = (
                 (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                 if changes is not None
                 else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
             )
             committed = status["committed"]
             pushed = status["pushed"]
             if committed is None:
                 committed = "not executed"
             if pushed is None:
                 pushed = "not executed"
             duration = time.monotonic() - started
             error = status["error"]
             if error is None:
                 _LOG.info(
                     "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
                 )
             else:
                 _LOG.error(
-                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
+                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
                     status["stage"],
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
-                    error,
                 )
         except BaseException:
             # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
             pass
 
     def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
         status = {
             "stage": "reader",
             "changes": None,
             "committed": None,
             "pushed": None,
             "error": None,
         }
         try:
             return self._sync_locked(status)
         except BaseException as error:
             status["error"] = error
             raise
         finally:
             try:
                 self._log_sync(started, status)
             finally:
                 self._lock.release()
 
     def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
         started = time.monotonic()
         self._lock.acquire()
         return self._run_locked(started)
 
     def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
         started = time.monotonic()
         if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
             return False
         self._run_locked(started)
         return True

 def test_pipeline_failure_stops_later_stages_and_releases_lock(tmp_path, failed_stage):
     snapshot = ThingsSnapshot()
     rendered = RenderedSnapshot({}, ())
     changes = ChangeSet()
     calls = []
     failure = {"stage": failed_stage}
     reader = Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(side_effect=lambda: calls.append("read") or snapshot))
 
     def render(value):

         if failure["stage"] == "renderer":

         return rendered
 
     def reconcile(repo, value):

         if failure["stage"] == "reconciler":
             raise RuntimeError("reconciler failed")
         return changes
 
     def git_sync(*args, **kwargs):
         calls.append("git")

     calls.clear()
     assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True

172	                return False
173	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
174	            if diff is None:
175	                return False
176	            if diff.returncode == 0:
177	                self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
178	                return False
179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)
265	
```

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )

1	```markdown
2	# AGENTS.md - Things3 to GitHub Markdown Sync Agent
3	
4	## Project Overview & Architecture
5	
6	### Core Mission
7	自动监听 Things3 数据库变化，实时将任务数据转换为结构化 Markdown 文件，并通过 Git 同步到 GitHub 仓库，保持任务管理数据的版本化备份与可读性。
8	
9	### Key Business Entities
10	- **Task（任务）**: Things3 核心实体，包含标题、状态、元数据、子任务
11	- **Project（项目）**: 任务容器，有独立文件夹结构
12	- **Area（领域）**: 更高层级的任务分组
13	- **Tag（标签）**: 跨项目的任务分类标记
14	
15	### Core Data Flow
16	```
17	Things3 SQLite DB 
18	  ↓ (watchdog 监听文件变化)
19	things.py 库解析
20	  ↓ (数据模型转换)
21	Markdown Generator (增量更新策略)
22	  ↓ (文件系统写入)
23	Git Operations (auto commit & push)
24	  ↓
25	GitHub Repository (远程备份)
26	```
27	
28	### Architecture Principles
29	- **事件驱动**: 文件监听 + 信号处理
30	- **增量优先**: 精确定位修改，减少 Git diff 噪音
31	- **容错设计**: 重试机制 + 日志追踪 + 全量校验兜底
32	- **零人工干预**: 后台服务 + 自动初始化
33	
34	---

36	## Tech Stack & Dependencies
37	
38	### Runtime Environment
39	- **OS**: macOS 10.14+（Things3 限定）
40	- **Python**: 3.6+ (推荐 3.9+)
41	- **Git**: 2.20+（系统命令行）
42	
43	### Core Dependencies
44	```
45	things.py>=0.2.0        # Things3 数据库接口
46	watchdog>=2.1.0         # 文件系统监听
47	python-dotenv>=0.19.0   # 环境配置管理
48	```
49	
50	### System Integration
51	- **launchd**: macOS 后台服务守护进程
52	- **Things3 数据库路径**: `~/Library/Group Containers/JLMPQHK86H.com.culturedcode.ThingsMac/Things Database.thingsdatabase/main.sqlite`
53	
54	---
55	
56	## Directory Structure & Conventions
57	
58	### Project Structure
59	```
60	things3-github-sync/
61	├── .env                      # 配置文件（Git ignore）
62	├── .env.example              # 配置模板
63	├── requirements.txt          # Python 依赖

67	├── main.py                   # 主程序入口
68	├── src/

136	## Codex Operational Rules
137	
138	### Pre-execution Checklist
139	在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：
140	1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
141	2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
142	3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
143	4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）
144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```

129	## 5. 下一步计划

139	Task 10 review clean 后，分别检查各任务的未提交内容。由于 Task 8、Task 9、Task 10 都在当前 workspace，不能使用 `git add .`。
140	
141	计划提交前应：
142	- 先确认用户是否希望现在创建功能提交；本会话之前明确要求实现代理不自行提交。
143	- 若提交，按任务拆分、显式列出路径并使用 `git commit --only`；不要把 `HANDOFF*`、nested worktree 条目、`.DS_Store`、`.gitignore` 或其他无关状态带入。
144	- 提交前检查 `git status --short`、`git diff --cached --name-status`、`git show --name-status HEAD`。
145	
146	### 第三步：Task 11 及以后
147	
148	按计划文件顺序：
149	- Task 11：setup.py 和 launchd plist preview。
150	- Task 12：临时 Git 仓库端到端集成测试。
151	- Task 13：README 与 Agent.md 对齐。
152	- Task 14：compileall、全套测试、禁止操作扫描、whole-branch review。
153	
154	每个任务必须有 brief、记录 BASE、implementer report、review package 和独立双 verdict review。
155	
156	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
157	
158	### Git 和分支
159	
160	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
161	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
162	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
163	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
164	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
165	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
166	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
167	
168	### SDD 流程
169	
170	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
171	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
172	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
173	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
174	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
175	- 未完成 Task 10 review 前不能开始 Task 11。
176	
177	### Things3 只读边界
178	
179	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
180	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
181	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
182	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
183	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
184	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
185	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
186	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
187	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
188	
189	### 文件系统和路径
190	
191	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
192	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
193	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
194	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
195	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
196	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
197	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
198	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
199	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
200	
201	### Git 实现
202	
203	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
204	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
205	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
206	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
207	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
208	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。
209	
210	### 日志隐私（本次会话反复踩到）
211	
212	- 所有错误日志必须使用固定消息，不得输出异常文本或 traceback。
213	- 任何包含数据库路径、仓库路径、token、auth-token、password 的异常消息都必须在日志外出现。
214	- 测试中要用含 `password=` 或 `/private/TARGET/...` 的异常做回归断言，证明敏感文本不在日志中。
215	- `logger.exception(...)` 在 watcher/service 代码中一律不用；用 `logger.error("固定消息")`。
216	
217	### 测试和环境
218	
219	- 优先使用 `/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python`，系统 Python 可能没有 pytest。
220	- 推荐命令：
221	```bash
222	/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
223	```
224	- 如果执行根目录 broad `pytest`，可能误收集被忽略的 `things.py/tests`，出现 `ModuleNotFoundError: tests.test_things`；这不是项目 `tests/` 套件失败。报告中要区分两者。
225	- 测试时避免产生不必要的 bytecode/cache；可用 `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider ...`。
226	- 每次任务的报告要记录 RED/GREEN 命令、精确输出和未执行的检查。
227	
228	### Workflow / 子代理
229	
230	- 本项目使用 Workflow 工具派发 implementer 与独立 reviewer，脚本必须是纯 JavaScript，不能用 TypeScript 语法。
231	- 脚本内的 agent prompt 如果包含反引号等特殊字符，会被解析器拒绝；用普通引号或拆分字符串。
232	- review agent 与 implementer 都可能因 `403 Insufficient account balance`、`504 openai_error` 或响应流解码错误而失败。失败时不要虚构结论，记录真实原因后重试，必要时改用更低成本模型（haiku）。
233	- 不要把实现代理自测当正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
234	
235	## 7. 继续开发的启动步骤
236	
237	新对话应按以下顺序操作：
238	
239	1. 阅读本文件。
240	2. 阅读 `Agent.md`、设计规格、实施计划和 `.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp/progress.md`。
241	3. 执行 `git status --short`、`git log --oneline --decorate -10`，确认当前 HEAD 与未提交文件；不要清理任何既有状态。
242	4. 检查 Task 10 最终 review 结果；若未完成，重新派发独立 reviewer。
243	5. Task 10 review clean 后，更新账本，再开始 Task 11。
244	6. 后续每个任务严格执行 brief -> BASE -> implementer -> report -> review -> fix/re-review -> ledger 的顺序。
245	
246	本交接文件不属于任何功能提交，除非用户明确要求提交它。

    def start(self) -> None:
        for emitter in self._emitters.copy():
            try:
                emitter.start()
            except Exception:
                self._remove_emitter(emitter)
                raise
        super().start()

    def join(self, timeout=None):
        """Wait until the thread terminates.

        This blocks the calling thread until the thread whose join() method is
        called terminates -- either normally or through an unhandled exception
        or until the optional timeout occurs.

        When the timeout argument is present and not None, it should be a
        floating point number specifying a timeout for the operation in seconds
        (or fractions thereof). As join() always returns None, you must call
        is_alive() after join() to decide whether a timeout happened -- if the
        thread is still alive, the join() call timed out.

        When the timeout argument is not present or None, the operation will
        block until the thread terminates.

        A thread can be join()ed many times.

        join() raises a RuntimeError if an attempt is made to join the current
        thread as that would cause a deadlock. It is also an error to join() a
        thread before it has been started and attempts to do so raises the same
        exception.

        """
        if not self._initialized:
            raise RuntimeError("Thread.__init__() not called")
        if not self._started.is_set():
            raise RuntimeError("cannot join thread before it is started")
        if self is current_thread():
            raise RuntimeError("cannot join current thread")

        if timeout is None:
            self._wait_for_tstate_lock()
        else:
            # the behavior of a negative timeout isn't documented, but
            # historically .join(timeout=x) for x<0 has acted as if timeout=0
            self._wait_for_tstate_lock(timeout=max(timeout, 0))

    def stop(self) -> None:
        BaseThread.stop(self)
        with contextlib.suppress(queue.Full):
            self.event_queue.put_nowait(EventDispatcher.stop_event)
